prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE full-bleed landscape 3:2 finished children's-book illustration, no text or panels. PRIMARY STYLE: luminous soft expressive animated forms consistent with approved study, cream face planes, readable hazel/amber iris around separate pupil, broad gentle lids, grouped sculpted short fur and quills. Mature Papa 1.6 times child height; dog shoulder 2.7 child heights. CRITICAL SCALE: when standing the dog shoulder is clearly HIGHER than Papa head, and its head is much higher; Papa reaches only dog shoulder lower edge. Never shrink Scooby to child-size companion. Papa hedgehog cream face, elongated mature muzzle and robust body, tipped brown-grey quills, NO glasses. PinPin small chestnut child. Scooby brown/brindle, white chest bib, cream-grey muzzle, short folded ears, curled tail, attentive meaningful gaze. All animals unclothed; ochre cloth bag is a carried prop, not clothing. No photoreal headshot/PBR materials, black button eyes, masks, saddles/reins/collars or humans. Exactly Papa, PinPin, Scooby; no Mama/baby/Elder copied from identity reference. Two forepaws and two hindlegs per hedgehog, four dog legs and one tail; occluded limbs stay hidden. Natural contact and believable support. Daylight only. No captions, borders, watermarks, montage, arrows or labels.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1: AUTHORITATIVE Papa/PinPin/Scooby identities and soft style, correct satchel contact/scale. NOT a montage layout to copy.; Image 2: Geography only. Use left stop/path for walking, right clearing for picnic. Not a split-panel layout; output ONE scene.; Image 3: Papa face/identity only, never transfer darkbackground or isolate as portrait.
SHOT ACTION AND CAMERA: Close low landing image: Papa stands on stone and supports PinPin around lower torso with BOTH forepaws as child hindfeet reach the SAME stone. Child two small paws rest Papa forearms. Dog shoulder/head to right watches, cropped body acceptable. Child is now off dog; no extra feet on its back. Papa bag follows right hip, not child.
